abstract: Verifies harbour berthing clearances and transit fuel consumption records
system_message:
You are Port operations coordinator (PRT). The Port operations coordinator (PRT) monitors harbour logistics, verifying port berthing clearances at designated emergency relief docks and maintaining audited transit fuel consumption records for rescue vessels. Additionally, this role tracks mooring line tensioning performance and vessel bollard pull strength ratings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Mooring line tensioning（MOOR）
information_points.content:
PRT-MOOR-VTU：Regarding mooring line tensioning, the Southern Cross Emergency Responder has an evaluated bollard pull strength rating of 75 t of continuous sustained static pull force on its stern towing winch.
PRT-MOOR-UZE：Regarding mooring line tensioning, the Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Vessel achieves a bollard pull strength rating of 45 t of continuous sustained static pull force at its stern towing winch.
PRT-MOOR-JKO：Regarding mooring line tensioning, the Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter demonstrates a bollard pull strength rating of 60 t of continuous sustained static pull force on its stern towing winch.

information_points.title: Verifies harbour berthing clearances and transit fuel consumption records（HARBOR）
information_points.content:
PRT-HARBOR-4EQ：The Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter has secured port berthing clearance for the designated emergency relief dock based on draft and beam compatibility. Its transit fuel consumption across the rated operational range is 300 t of marine diesel oil.
PRT-HARBOR-NGS：The Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Vessel possesses valid port berthing clearance for rapid emergency berthing at the designated emergency relief dock. During transit across its rated operational voyage profile, its total transit fuel consumption is 375 t.
PRT-HARBOR-SRF：The Southern Cross Emergency Responder lacks port berthing clearance for rapid emergency berthing at the designated emergency relief dock. Its transit fuel consumption across its operational voyage range is recorded at 250 t.
